business_problem: build a unified ML pipeline that could mine terabytes of web data from millions of private companies without costly data movement or fragmented infrastructure.
solution_summary: S&P Global Market Intelligence uses Snowflake, Snowpark, and Snowpark Container Services on Snowflake to build a unified ML pipeline that could mine terabytes of web data from millions of private companies without costly data movement or fragmented infrastructure. Web-crawled, firmographic, and risk data are centralized in Snowflake so risk analysts and product teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. S&P Global Market Intelligence achieved 200M+ webpages mined for data to enhance risk assessment.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

solution_components.name: Snowpark Container Services
solution_components.role: Runs containerized ML, privacy, or application workloads directly against Snowflake-managed data.
